# Shutap

> Shutap is the humor amplifier. Type what happened and Shutap amplifies it into a bit in your voice — hook, setup, tags and a button — with a 5-second video, a caption and hashtags, then runs it as stand-up, lays it out as a skit, or formats it as a one-page sketch. Film it for TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts, take it to the stage, or bring it to a toast, a talk or a meeting. Shutap amplifies your humor; it never replaces it. Your stories and jokes stay yours. Identifying details are removed from stories before storage, and Shutap never uses your content to train AI. Its writing is guided by the Shutap Humor Amplifier Lab dataset, an in-house joke dataset the Shutap team writes, selects and rates. The Humor Amplifier Lab is Shutap's research arm: the dataset, The funniest series and the work behind Shutap Enterprise.

The brand line is "SHUTAP. Say it funnier." The first bit needs no account. Signing in is free and lets you rewrite and download it; Basic ($7.99/month) and Pro ($49.99/month) remove the watermark on downloads. A "wild" setting runs from 1 (true to your story) to 5 (goes wild). Shutap writes jokes about the situation, never about a real person someone could identify. It is an entertainment tool, not a healthcare, mental-health, crisis or legal service. 18+.

## Core

- [What Shutap is](https://shutap.com/about): The humor amplifier — storytime, POV, talking-head and skit videos, first drafts for stand-up, toasts and talks. It amplifies your humor; it never replaces it.
- [How it works](https://shutap.com/how-it-works): Type what happened, names and places are removed, get the bit with its video, caption and hashtags, then pick stand-up, sketch or skit.
- [Pricing](https://shutap.com/pricing): Free to write, with one watermarked download a day; Basic ($7.99/mo) gives 3 clean downloads a day, Pro ($49.99/mo) unlimited downloads and the Mirror.
- [FAQ](https://shutap.com/faq): Is it free, can I use the bits in my own videos and sets, is my name on anything, what can I post.
- [Trust & privacy](https://shutap.com/trust): Names and places removed from stories before saving, private until you post, never used to train AI, takedown path.

## Guides and tools

- [The humor amplifier](https://shutap.com/humor-amplifier): Turn what happened into a post: a bit in your voice, a 5-second video, a caption and hashtags.
- [All guides and tools](https://shutap.com/guides): Index of the pages below.
- [Storytime script writer](https://shutap.com/guides/storytime-script-writer): Turn a story into a script with a hook, setup, tags and a button.
- [Stand-up bit writer](https://shutap.com/guides/stand-up-bit-writer): A first draft of a bit from a real story.
- [POV and skit writer](https://shutap.com/guides/pov-skit-writer): See a bit as a scene, beat by beat.
- [Teleprompter for comedy](https://shutap.com/guides/comedy-teleprompter): Run any bit full-screen and read it to camera.
- [Comedy screenplay page formatter](https://shutap.com/guides/comedy-screenplay-format): A bit laid out as a script page.
- [How Shutap is built](https://shutap.com/guides/how-shutap-is-built): Observations, whole bits, rules in code, a judge model, and hotter/tighter/storytelling/mix-your-own controls.
- [Shutap vs Punchlines.ai](https://shutap.com/guides/shutap-vs-punchlines-ai): One-liners from headlines versus a whole bit from your own story.
- [Humor is wisdom](https://shutap.com/guides/humor-is-wisdom): The founder's vision and why Shutap exists.
- [AI joke tools compared](https://shutap.com/guides/ai-joke-tools-compared): Shutap, Witscript, Punchlines.ai and ChatGPT side by side.
- [Shutap vs Witscript](https://shutap.com/guides/shutap-vs-witscript): Setup-to-jokes versus story-to-bit.
- [Shutap vs ChatGPT and Claude for jokes](https://shutap.com/guides/shutap-vs-chatgpt-for-jokes): General assistants versus a tool built for bits.
- [Shutap vs Claude for jokes](https://shutap.com/guides/shutap-vs-claude-for-jokes): A general assistant versus a tool built for bits, with daily ideas and technique guides.
- [Shutap Enterprise overview](https://shutap.com/guides/funny-for-business): Direction: humor for presentations, roadshows, demos, launches and meetings (in development).
- [Make presentations and slides funny](https://shutap.com/guides/funny-presentations-and-slides): Where to put humor in a deck and how to write it.
- [Funny product demos and launches](https://shutap.com/guides/funny-product-demos-and-launches): Humor for demos, launches and roadshows from real stories.
- [How to turn a story into a bit](https://shutap.com/guides/how-to-turn-a-story-into-a-bit): Moment, detail, hook, setup, tags, button.
- [How long should a TikTok bit be](https://shutap.com/guides/how-long-should-a-tiktok-bit-be): Word counts for 15s, 30s, 60s and 2 minute bits.
- [How to write comedy tags](https://shutap.com/guides/how-to-write-comedy-tags): What a tag is, how to find one, how many to write.

- [Shutap Enterprise](https://shutap.com/business): Request pricing and a tailored solution for humor in presentations, demos, launches and meetings, or ask about the Shutap Humor Amplifier Lab dataset (in development).

- [The funniest people and their techniques](https://shutap.com/funniest): Who is widely considered the funniest president, billionaire, actor, philosopher and more, with sources, and the techniques you can take from each.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://shutap.com/terms): The rules; 18+.
- [Privacy Policy](https://shutap.com/privacy): No sale of data; access, export and delete rights.
- [House rules](https://shutap.com/guidelines): Jokes go at the situation, not at a person.
- [If it's heavy](https://shutap.com/safety): Crisis resources, and how Shutap stops joking and points to real help.
- [AI Disclosure](https://shutap.com/ai-disclosure): The bits are written by AI. It gets things wrong and gives no medical, mental-health or legal advice.
- [Legal hub](https://shutap.com/legal): Index of all policy pages.
